known.via: English Wikipedia "Mendocino County AVA" (redirects to "Mendocino County wine")

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A county appellation for wine from grapes grown mostly in Mendocino County, one of California's largest and most climatically diverse regions, with two climate zones split by the Mendocino Range. Nearly 25% of plantings are organic, and Chardonnay leads at 27%.
